text_block_list.text:
With the Asahi Hai F.S. drawing closer,

Марузенски is enjoying her time training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One day, Спешл Уик and Grass
Wonder
request to practice alongside
their role model,
Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Moved by the passion of the younger
students,
Марузенски gets even more
fired up for the Asahi
Hai F.S.!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
